blocks.text: Supervised machine learning training ke liye labeled data istemal karti hai. Har data item ka ek input aur ek sahi output hota hai. System apna output sahi jawab se mila kar seekhta hai, jaise ustad ki nigrani (supervision) mein. Is ke liye bare labeled datasets chahiye, jaise emails jin par "spam" ya "not spam" likha ho, tasaveer jin par "cat" ya "dog" likha ho, ya medical scans jin par "normal" ya "abnormal" likha ho. Zyada aur achhi quality ki misalon par train karne se is ki accuracy aam taur par barhti hai. Asal applications mein is ka bohat istemal hai: face recognition (chehre ki pehchan), bimari ki pehchan, speech recognition (awaz pehchanna), fraud detection (dhoka pakarna) aur recommendation systems (pasand ki cheezein tajweez karna). Yeh tareeqa prediction (andaza lagane) ke kaamon mein istemal hota hai, maslan email spam pakarna aur imtihan ke result ka andaza.
